queries.question: How much paid vacation does a full-time employee get each year?
queries.expected_answer: 20 days
queries.relevant_text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave during each calendar year.

queries.question: Can the professional-development allowance pay for a certification, and what is its yearly limit?
queries.expected_answer: Yes. The annual limit is $1,200.
queries.relevant_text: Every full-time employee has an annual professional-development budget of $1,200. The budget may be used for relevant courses, books, certifications, and conferences after manager approval.

queries.question: When are formal employee evaluations held?
queries.expected_answer: Twice a year, in June and December.
queries.relevant_text: Formal performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December.

queries.question: What is the minimum permitted company-account password length?
queries.expected_answer: 14 characters
queries.relevant_text: Every company account must use a password containing at least 14 characters.

queries.question: How quickly should staff notify the security team after noticing a possible breach?
queries.expected_answer: Within one hour of discovery.
queries.relevant_text: Employees must report a suspected security incident to the security team within one hour of discovery.

queries.question: Which kinds of information are defined as restricted data?
queries.expected_answer: Authentication secrets, private encryption keys, and regulated customer records.
queries.relevant_text: Restricted data includes authentication secrets, private encryption keys, and regulated customer records.

queries.question: What nightly room rate can a traveler normally expense before tax?
queries.expected_answer: $180 per night before taxes.
queries.relevant_text: The standard hotel limit is $180 per night before taxes.

queries.question: Under what conditions is premium economy allowed?
queries.expected_answer: For flights of at least six hours with advance department-head approval.
queries.relevant_text: Premium economy may be booked for a flight lasting six hours or longer when the department head approves it before purchase.

queries.question: After coming home from a business trip, how long do I have to file expenses?
queries.expected_answer: 15 calendar days.
queries.relevant_text: An expense report must be submitted within 15 calendar days after the traveler returns.

queries.question: What weekly schedule is considered standard for employees?
queries.expected_answer: Forty hours, normally from Monday through Friday.
queries.relevant_text: The standard work week is forty hours, normally completed from Monday through Friday.

queries.question: How often may an employee work away from the office, and whose agreement is needed?
queries.expected_answer: Up to three days per week after agreeing on a schedule with their manager.
queries.relevant_text: Employees may work remotely for up to three days each week after agreeing on a schedule with their manager.

queries.question: Why are recently hired staff expected to be on-site at first?
queries.expected_answer: To complete equipment setup and introductions during their first two weeks.
queries.relevant_text: New employees should complete their first two weeks from the office so that equipment setup and introductions can be completed.

queries.question: What advance notice applies when someone wants more than five consecutive working days off?
queries.expected_answer: The request should be submitted at least four weeks in advance.
queries.relevant_text: Leave requests longer than five consecutive working days should be submitted at least four weeks in advance.

queries.question: What is the yearly paid absence allowance when an employee is ill?
queries.expected_answer: Up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year.
queries.relevant_text: Employees may take up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year.

queries.question: At what point does a sickness absence require documentation from a doctor?
queries.expected_answer: When it continues for more than three consecutive working days.
queries.relevant_text: A medical certificate is required when an absence continues for more than three consecutive working days.

queries.question: Is ordinary computer equipment an eligible professional-development purchase?
queries.expected_answer: No, general-purpose computer hardware is not eligible.
queries.relevant_text: It cannot be used to buy general-purpose computer hardware.

queries.question: For which company services is a second authentication factor compulsory?
queries.expected_answer: Email, source-code hosting, cloud infrastructure, and administrative systems.
queries.relevant_text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, source-code hosting, cloud infrastructure, and administrative systems.

queries.question: What should an employee do with evidence after a possible security event, and what investigation should they avoid?
queries.expected_answer: Preserve relevant evidence and do not attempt a personal forensic investigation.
queries.relevant_text: Employees should preserve relevant evidence and avoid attempting their own forensic investigation.

queries.question: What are the four sensitivity categories used for company information?
queries.expected_answer: Public, internal, confidential, and restricted.
queries.relevant_text: Company information is classified as public, internal, confidential, or restricted.

queries.question: How must the most sensitive data be stored and protected while moving or at rest?
queries.expected_answer: Only in explicitly approved systems, encrypted both in transit and at rest.
queries.relevant_text: Restricted data may only be stored in explicitly approved systems and must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.

queries.question: After how much idle time must a work laptop lock itself?
queries.expected_answer: Ten minutes.
queries.relevant_text: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and automatically lock after ten minutes of inactivity.

queries.question: How soon after release should operating-system security patches be applied?
queries.expected_answer: Within seven days of release.
queries.relevant_text: Operating-system security updates must be installed within seven days of release.

queries.question: What governance is required before an outside provider receives access, and how frequently are its permissions checked?
queries.expected_answer: It needs a named internal owner, documented business purpose, and expiration date; permissions are reviewed quarterly.
queries.relevant_text: Third-party access must have a named internal owner, a documented business purpose, and an expiration date. Vendor permissions must follow the principle of least privilege and must be reviewed every quarter.

queries.question: Where are staff expected to arrange authorized work trips?
queries.expected_answer: Through the company travel portal.
queries.relevant_text: Employees should book approved business travel through the company travel portal.

queries.question: When is lodging above the normal nightly ceiling acceptable?
queries.expected_answer: When the conference hotel is required or no safe, practical option is available within the limit.
queries.relevant_text: A higher rate is allowed when the conference hotel is required or when no safe, practical option is available within the limit.

queries.question: What is the maximum daily food reimbursement while traveling?
queries.expected_answer: $65 per day.
queries.relevant_text: Travelers may claim meal expenses up to $65 per day.

queries.question: Which individual purchases need an itemized receipt?
queries.expected_answer: Any individual expense of $25 or more.
queries.relevant_text: Alcohol is not reimbursable, and itemized receipts are required for any individual expense of $25 or more.

queries.question: Can a traveler expense food that a conference or client already supplied?
queries.expected_answer: No, meals already provided should not be claimed again.
queries.relevant_text: Meals already provided by a hotel, conference, or client should not be claimed again.

queries.question: What local transportation option should be preferred when conditions permit?
queries.expected_answer: Public transportation, when it is safe and practical.
queries.relevant_text: Public transportation should be used when it is safe and practical.

queries.question: May an employee hire a car for a work trip without asking first?
queries.expected_answer: No, car rentals require advance manager approval.
queries.relevant_text: Car rentals require advance manager approval.
